sf6.observable: Nominal isotope molecule charge divided by A times the positive electron charge magnitude. The publication translates it to equal proton+electron and neutron residuals.

scope: Additional family-universal quark charges, three lepton families, one right neutrino per family, no other matter anomaly; single ordinary long-range charge, no field-dependent electron unit or hidden transfer. Independent real measurements, no statistical coverage is assigned to marginal working boxes.
